purpose: Phase 0 (baseline/evidence rescue) durable capture of GitHub Actions source-run metadata, arm/configuration identity, and artifact locators for the six 2026-09-09 workflow runs used to reconcile the #1996 hint-provenance repeat-run determinism audit, before their GHA artifacts expire.

environmentConstraint.summary: This rescue session's outbound network egress policy denies connections to productionresultssa18.blob.core.windows.net (GitHub Actions artifact storage), so raw artifact ZIP bytes (result.json, manifest.json, batch-*.json per-shard payloads) could not be downloaded in this session even though the GitHub API confirmed all six runs' artifacts are unexpired.
environmentConstraint.evidenceCapturedInstead: Workflow/job/run metadata and job-log text via the GitHub Actions API (api.github.com), which is not subject to the same block. This includes the parameterized workflow display name (which encodes the dispatched arm), head commit/ref, per-job conclusions, and the verbatim human-readable result-summary markdown that scripts/publish-solver-sweep-result.mjs prints to the combine job's log before uploading the solver-sweep-result artifact.
environmentConstraint.notRescued: Exact per-level result.json rows and manifest.json dispatch-input payloads for these six runs remain only inside the still-unexpired (see artifacts[].expiresAt below, currently 2026-12-08) solver-sweep-result/targeted-sweep-combined artifacts. A session with Azure Blob Storage egress access should download and durably archive those artifacts verbatim before that expiry if full row-level replay fidelity for this cohort is later required by Phase 7 (authoritative historical enrichment).
environmentConstraint.mitigatingFactor: The discoveries these runs actually contributed already persisted into the tracked canonical hint corpus (data/stress/hints*) via the normal harvest path at the time; the #1996 audit read them from there, not from these artifacts. This rescue therefore captures the arm/source-run binding context that is NOT already durable in git, rather than duplicating path/provenance bytes that already are.
